# gitmoap_group_approval_policy (Resource)

Sets whether a merge request's author, its committers and its last pusher may approve it, and whether a push resets approvals, for every repository beneath that sets nothing nearer. Maintainers and above may set it; making it enforced, so everything beneath may only be stricter, or changing it once enforced needs an Owner. A setting looser than a policy enforced above is refused.

The token needs `approval_rule:manage` and `approval_rule:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `author_can_approve` (Boolean)
- `committers_can_approve` (Boolean)
- `group_id` (String) Group ID
- `last_pusher_can_approve` (Boolean)
- `reset_on_push` (Boolean)

### Optional

- `enforcement` (String) Whether the scopes beneath may replace a rule, or only strengthen it.

### Read-Only

- `effective` (Attributes) Who may not approve, whatever the rules say — and whether approvals survive a push. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--effective))
- `policy` (Attributes) A group's or repository's approval policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policy))
- `rules` (Attributes List) The rules that apply to merge requests here: every enforced rule above, as strengthened
beneath, then the nearest group's or repository's own rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `rules_here` (Attributes List) The rules this group or repository defines itself. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules_here))

Read-Only:

- `last_pusher_can_approve` (Boolean) Whether whoever pushed its current head may approve it.
- `reset_on_push` (Boolean) Whether an approval stops counting when new commits are pushed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its group_id.
terraform import gitmoap_group_approval_policy.example "<group_id>"
```
